role: Canonical Montreal road-segment geometry, road names, segment identifiers and road classes.
scientific_warning: None. This is the canonical geospatial base map of Montreal's road network.
notes: Used as the core link for spatial joins and network segmentation.

official_name: Travaux de colmatage mécanisé de nid-de-poule
role: Primary recorded road-repair event source for constructing the 90-day classification target.
scientific_warning: Records start Dec 2016. Excludes borough and manual repairs. Concentrated on arterial network. GPS accuracy varies. Duplicate coordinates/timestamps legitimately occur due to nearby repairs; do not deduplicate prior to audit rules. Landing-page temporal metadata may be inconsistent with files.
notes: All 10 of 10 annual resource files (2016-2025) have been downloaded, verified, and audited; see data/metadata/pothole_resource_manifest.csv.

official_name: Chaussée agrégée et intersection — Base de données des actifs de voirie
role: Candidate construction date, resurfacing date, pavement material, foundation and road-surface-age information.
crs_wording: The raw GeoJSON contains no explicit crs member. Its longitude/latitude coordinates are consistent with GeoJSON coordinate conventions and Montréal, but no project working CRS is approved in Phase 2.
scientific_warning: Resurfacing dates are 86.74% missing. Construction dates are 88.57% unknown or highly imprecise (+/- 100 years). Date logic anomalies present (133 records). Direct ID join to Géobase is unverified.
notes: ZIP file contains VOI_CHAUSSEE_S_C22_GeoJSON.json (uncompressed 159981330 bytes, 64025 valid features). CSV dictionary contains 184 data rows. Checked ignore: ignored by data/raw/*.

official_name: Indicateurs de condition des chaussées du réseau routier
role: Pavement Condition Index (PCI) and International Roughness Index (IRI) indicators.
scientific_warning: Irregular campaign coverage and network scopes (e.g. 2022 local, 2024 arterial). Coding shifts (CSV, CP1252 GeoJSON, GPKG). ID matching rate with current Géobase ranges from 94.49% to 99.58%. 2020 contains 99 duplicate feature records and 1,326 missing-data IRI sentinels.
notes: Six campaign resources have been verified and audited; see data/metadata/pavement_condition_resource_manifest.csv.

official_name: Limites administratives de l’agglomération de Montréal
role: Borough assignment, related municipalities assignment, subgroup evaluation and dashboard filters.
scientific_warning: Static late-2023 snapshot applied to 2016-2025 repair data, causing potential temporal mismatches. Related municipalities are missing from Géobase road segment attributes. 1,084 segments cross boundaries. Portal WGS 84 transformations are unvalidated by the city.
notes: Verified GeoJSON has 34 features (19 Arrondissements, 15 Villes liées). Total area is 619,200,849.51 m^2. Checked ignore: ignored by data/raw/*.

official_name: Environment and Climate Change Canada historical daily weather
role: Daily minimum temperature, maximum temperature, mean temperature, precipitation, snowfall and freeze–thaw features.
scientific_warning: McTavish Total Rain and Total Snow are 100% missing. Montréal-Trudeau Total Snow is 100% missing, while Total Rain has only 23 populated observations and 6,186 missing observations (99.63% missing). Therefore, the separate Total Rain and Total Snow fields are not suitable as consistent cross-year features. Total Precip is the usable precipitation measurement, subject to its documented missingness.
notes: Verified 34 annual CSVs + 1 station inventory. McTavish has 104 mean temp missing; Trudeau has 776. Mean temp correlation is 0.998. Checked ignore: ignored by data/raw/*.

scientific_warning: Traffic counts represent localized snapshots. Spatial density and historical overlap may be highly limited.
